content: The Roc GitHub badge for your project may show "custom badge inaccessible" due to new scraping protections on pastebin. I will set something up with the official Roc lang website (through cloudflare).

You can now fix this by replacing the pastebin url with the encoded Roc URL: https%3A%2F%2Froc-lang.org%2Fbadge%2Froc.json
